items.title: Introducing rocOpt: GPU-Accelerated Decision Optimization on AMD ROCm
items.summary: rocOpt is a new open-source, GPU-accelerated engine for decision optimization on AMD Instinct GPUs. It solves large-scale linear programming (LP), mixed-integer linear programming (MILP), quadratic programming (QP), and vehicle routing problems on the ROCm software stack, and is ready for early users today on MI300X and MI355X with ROCm 7.2.3.

items.title: ‘I’m alive’: Paris street medic isn’t dead, despite viral claims he was killed by police

But the street medic is alive, and spoke to FRANCE 24. Vedika Bahl explains in Truth or Fake.
